title: Schedule UI polish after the trust pass
lede: Staff and students should read one honest row for combined events, see every area they work, and never confuse a failed Trade Board count or a private crew edit with an empty board.

sections.heading: After-only
sections.note: No trustworthy matched pair. The checkout already carried the Schedule trust-pass dirty tree, no isolated baseline was captured before this polish, and WisconsinPerformance ScheduleScreenshotUITests crashed at bootstrap (signal term) on iPhone 16 Pro iOS 27.0.

changes.h: Claim pause spoke on every open slot
changes.was: Each empty Student slot repeated “Staff are updating this crew,” so a six-slot crew looked like six problems.
changes.now: One crew-level notice on Schedule disclosure and Event detail. Claim buttons stay hidden until the draft releases.

changes.h: Combined events were silent on native rows
changes.was: Web named “N events · shared crew.” iOS collapsed the row but did not say why two games shared one crew.
changes.now: Native list and Event detail use the same shared-crew cue. Web mobile list and timed multi-day rows also name the span.

changes.was: Dictionary uniquing kept only the earliest shift, so Photo vanished when Camera was also assigned.
changes.now: The list names every extra area. Event detail lists each personal assignment.

changes.h: Publish now sat under history controls
changes.was: Undo, Redo, and Revert led the pending card; Publish now was the last button. Ended drafts still advertised the 10-minute timer.
changes.now: Publish now / Apply correction now is the primary action. Ended pending copies omit the timer copy.

changes.h: A failed Trade Board count looked like zero trades
changes.was: A non-OK fetch returned 0 and overwrote a known count in the React Query cache.
changes.now: The count fetch throws, so a failure keeps the last good number and does not show a 0 badge.

verification: 22 focused web source tests across claim-surfaces, ios-schedule-mvp-parity, ios-schedule-ui-cleanup, ios-schedule-working-copy, and calendar-event-dates.

Week view, combine authoring, and auto-assign stay web-only. GAP-75 live Cross Country combine and signed-in staff-edit → student-read → Publish now remain open.
